problem: Given that $‖4u+v‖=22$ and $‖v‖=2$, find the smallest possible value of $‖u‖.$
worked_solution:
Using the triangle inequality, we have that

$$
\begin{aligned}‖4u+v‖ & \le ‖4u‖+‖v‖.\end{aligned}
$$

Simplifying and substituting in the given information, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}‖4u+v‖ & \le 4‖u‖+‖v‖ \\ 22 & \le 4‖u‖+2 \\ 20 & \le 4‖u‖ \\ 5 & \le ‖u‖.\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the smallest possible value of $‖u‖$ is $5.$
